USDL-25-0100

THE EMPLOYMENT SITUATION -- JANUARY 2025

Total nonfarm payroll employment increased by 150,000 in January, and the unemployment rate remained at 4.1 percent, the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics reported today.

The labor force participation rate, at 62.5 percent, was unchanged over the month.

In January, average hourly earnings for all employees on private nonfarm payrolls rose by 10 cents, or 0.3 percent, to $35.80. Over the past 12 months, average hourly earnings have increased by 3.9 percent.
